paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The average performance of all models on Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness categories.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of various language models across three categories: Understanding, Reasoning, and Trustworthiness. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models, while the vertical axis represents the percentage values ranging from 0% to 100%. In the Understanding category, the tallest bar corresponds to gpt-4o-2024-11-20 at approximately 98%, and the shortest bar corresponds to Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 2.4%. In the Reasoning category, the tallest bar corresponds to gpt-4o-2024-11-20 at 66.5%, and the shortest bar corresponds to Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 7.2%. In the Trustworthiness category, the tallest bar corresponds to Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M at 71.8%, and the shortest bar corresponds to Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 at 0.0%. Each model's performance is represented by two bars, with blue and dark blue colors, but the exact meaning of the colors is not specified. The models are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
